mappings.product_miss: The normalized Försäkringskassan job-premium record already exists, but the public situation/person intelligence has no explicit route for the reverse transition from municipal social assistance to employment salary. Without a guarded route, the product can either miss a time-limited support candidate or overgeneralize from vague facts such as 'I had social assistance last year and now work'.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Keep one Stödassistenten. When the public person intelligence is extended, recognize the reverse transition from municipal social assistance to employment salary and ask only fixed-period, claim-month, household and deadline-changing facts. Do not create a job-premium app and do not treat the existing normalized support record as proof that the public route is complete.
mappings.truth_guardrail: The normalized support remains NEEDS_REVIEW with material_fields_verified empty. Eligibility, amount, duration, historical qualification period, household rule, deadline and application channel must be checked against the current Försäkringskassan primary source before they become truth-bearing behavior.
mappings.privacy_guardrail: Synthetic cases contain no real case data. Do not copy exact wages, household identities, municipal case details, personal identifiers or raw social-assistance history into public eval data, handoff URLs or anonymous product feedback.
